instruments.notes: Financial gas price hedging instruments (financial price swaps, fixed price received); approx. 6% of expected 2000 total production; no price stated in text
instruments.evidence_quote:
As of year-end 1999, Devon had financial gas price hedging instruments
in place which represented approximately 18 Bcf, 13 Bcf and 3 Bcf of gas
production in the years 2000, 2001 and 2002, respectively.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Periodically uses financial price swaps (receive fixed) on a portion of oil and gas production, plus fixed-price Canadian gas contracts; not for trading; gains/losses recognized in oil and gas sales.
